name: argus
description: Argus is a Codex QA/QE plugin for web apps: live audits, demo capture, Playwright non-regression harness, accessibility, Core Web Vitals, visual regression, links, console/network, security checks, and CI reports.

interface.shortDescription: Audit web apps and install a Playwright QA harness.
interface.longDescription: Argus helps Codex audit live web applications, install a deterministic Playwright non-regression harness, check accessibility, performance, links, console/network health, security headers/authz, and generate CI-ready reports.
defaultPrompt: Installe Argus dans ce projet et prepare la config.
Audite cette application web avec Argus.
Transforme ces findings QA en specs Playwright.
